source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check information in release note
1. General information
2. FW Version
3. New features/Issues fixed list
4. Known issue

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. All information should be readable and no spelling error
2. FW Version should be correct
3. Procedures & Criteria of new features, which issues fixed and known issues should be clear

original_test_intent: Review the exact BMC release note for readable, correctly spelled general information, the approved firmware version, and clear new-feature, fixed-issue and known-issue descriptions/procedures/criteria.
original_method: Hash and extract the unmodified note, bind it to the target BMC image/package and approved manifest/change sources, run section/version/spelling/completeness checks and present ambiguities for release-owner verdict; never flash in this row.
manual_activity: A release owner supplies authoritative artifacts and decides the formal verdict; extraction, linting, cross-reference and evidence generation are automated.
safety_requirements: Do not execute SF600 or any firmware write; it belongs to another same-code variant.
Bind all analysis to source row 711 and the exact package identity.
Preserve layout/context and original artifact when extracting or OCRing.
Quarantine inconsistencies; do not select or flash a package based on an ambiguous note.
agent_execution_scope: Extract and index sections, lint spelling/readability, compare version/package identifiers and cross-check feature/fix/issue coverage with approved sources.
Produce cited discrepancies and evidence while leaving release acceptance to the owner.
engineer_actions: Supply and approve source-of-truth release/package artifacts and exception policy.
Resolve semantic ambiguities and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: SF600 physical flashing is a different same-code row and is prohibited here.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only document extraction/OCR, spell/language checking and structured manifest comparison with page/section citations.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The release-note scope and 10/0-minute values remain; no firmware operation is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.status: HASHED RELEASE-NOTE TO PACKAGE TRACEABILITY REVIEW
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Link the note, image and approved manifest by immutable identifiers and generate a section-level matrix for version, features, fixes, known issues and required validation criteria.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record document, image/package, extractor/OCR and checker versions/hashes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Release-owner-approved BMC package manifest and change/issue sources.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact artifact identity, traceability and structured checks while preserving owner semantic judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects stale notes, wrong versions, missing issues, unclear validation requirements and reused-code overlay contamination.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Language tools can flag ambiguity but the release owner decides technical completeness.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define language, package and required sections, but cannot reuse the SF600 method or accept an unbound note for a different image.
expected_evidence: Target image/package/hash and expected version source

blocked_analysis.analysis: The documentation core is fully automatable after artifacts are supplied; missing inputs or owner verdict do not reduce capability.
